==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in an interesting tunnel of energy. The tunnel glows and changes colors. I can feel that the space within the tunnel is malleable and can be shaped by my imagination.

I hear a loud sound from the waking world. In reaction to the sound, everything in the dream fades away into darkness. I become lucid rather than fully waking up, but I feel like I am about to awaken.

I fight to stay in the dream. I focus on my memories of the tunnel. The darkness around me subsides and  the tunnel returns.

But I lose my lucidity, and the dream devolves into a series of random events until eventually I wake up.
